title: Paint Your Pet- December Craft+Canvas @ Chaos Brewing
seo_title: Paint Your Pet Craft+Canvas at Chaos Brewing, Joplin
description: This is a guided acrylic painting class where you paint a portrait of your pet on an 11x14 or 16x20 canvas, following step-by-step instructions while the studio artist paints along and helps one-on-one. No experience is needed, and supplies plus your first glass of Chaos Craft Beer are included; it is for ages 21 and up, and you send a clear photo of your pet ahead of time (registration closes November 26). It takes place Thursday, December 3, 2026, 6:30 to 9:00 PM at Chaos Brewing Company, 118 S Main St in Joplin, MO.
